about: Retail auto-resolve battle outcomes (q4hf t03), reduced from a Q2 kit run of the original game. Not graded yet: the harness has no battle-level check (tools/parity/README.md, Gaps). Forces are the store objects under the planet (planet -> fleet / transport -> members) on the last sample before the battle; losses are the objects flagged dead or gone when the result was applied, cross-checked with the result screens (autoresolve_*_result.jpg in the run folder). A company is a transport (GALLOFREE_TRANSPORT, IMPERIAL_LANDING_CRAFT, IMPERIAL_ATAT_BARGE) and its members; a squadron is a GALACTIC_SQUADRON and its fighters. Players: 0 Rebel (AI), 1 Empire (human, idle), 6 Underworld (AI). gf = global frame, tick = mode frame (galactic ticks done).
scenario: Sandbox_Heart_Of_The_Maw_Empire, human Empire, Medium, seed 0, 40 cycles; hands-off up to the first battle the human had to answer

grade_about: bkc1 t08: 'grade' is the machine-readable form of each battle for tools/parity/autoresolve_check.py (ctest parity_autoresolve): port type names of the combatants in auto-resolve list order (defender units, attacker units, then the defender's structures / starbase), side flags (Rebel AI, Empire human, both playable), the retail winner and the retail combatants destroyed by type (types not listed: 0). The check runs the port's auto-resolve over 200 seeds and passes when the winner matches in >= 90% of them and every retail loss count and the starbase outcome lie inside the port's 5th..95th percentile band (parity tier 2: distribution, docs/DECISIONS.md). Per side, the total destroyed is graded the same way. 'known_fail' names checks that fail for a known reason with their backlog entry: reported KNOWN, not failing the ctest (as baseline.json does for the harness).
